description.value: Chatime is a global bubble tea franchise known for its wide range of customizable milk teas, fruit teas, and specialty cold drinks. This Nanaimo location sits at Unit 520 in a commercial strip along Island Highway North, a major arterial route through the city. It is a takeout-focused spot well-suited for cyclists wanting a cold, sweet drink on a warm riding day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL listed in OSM (chatimebc.com) resolves to a domain-for-sale page on HugeDomains, so no business content is available from the website. All amenity data must come from OSM tags alone: takeaway=yes confirms takeout service; cuisine=bubble_tea and brand=Chatime confirm the business type. No OSM tags address bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities, so those remain null. The domain being for sale is flagged as a concern, though looks_closed=false in the OSM record.
concerns: The OSM website URL (http://www.chatimebc.com) now resolves to a domain-for-sale page on HugeDomains. The regional Chatime BC website appears to have shut down, though the physical store may still be operating. Phone number and open status could not be independently verified.
No unit number included in the address field; OSM records addr:unit=520 which should be noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Chatime is a real, established international franchise with a plausible OSM record and looks_closed=false; the lapsed domain is a concern but not evidence the physical location is closed.
enrichment_extras.notes: Full address per OSM: Unit 520, 2980 Island Highway North, Nanaimo, BC.
